minutes.headline: Zoning Board granted special permits for front-setback relief for a deck and porch at 21 Brookview Terrace.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard a single petition from the owners of 21 Brookview Terrace. They want to rebuild and extend a deck they removed as unsafe, and add a front porch. Both fall inside the 40-foot front setback. No one from the public spoke. A member moved to approve both reliefs, the vote was reported as five in favor, and the chair read the post-decision instructions before adjourning.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted special permits for a rebuilt deck and a new front porch at 21 Brookview Terrace; the vote was reported as 5-0.
Both structures fall inside the 40-foot front setback, so the board approved dimensional relief for each, as shown on the submitted plans.
The permits are subject to compliance with all applicable licenses, regulations, statutes and ordinances.
The board advised the applicant to wait about 30 days before building because of the appeal period.

why_it_matters: This was a single-property petition with no budget item and no public comment, so it touches only the neighbors of 21 Brookview Terrace, who could still appeal during the roughly 30-day window.
watch_next: The end of the appeal period, about 30 days after the decision, before construction at 21 Brookview Terrace can begin.
